name: Scattered Spider – APT Threat Map
description: Técnicas de Scattered Spider com cobertura do catálogo (score 3=regra, 2=parcial, 1=lacuna)

techniques.comment: Scattered Spider has extracted the `NTDS.dit` file by creating volume shadow copies of virtual domain controller disks. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has created volume shadow copies of virtual domain controller disks to extract the `NTDS.dit` file. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used network reconnaissance commands for discovery including `ping` and `nltest`. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider can enumerate remote systems, such as VMware vCenter infrastructure. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used RDP to enable lateral movement. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used SSH to move laterally in victim environments and to access the vSphere vCenter Server GUI. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has also leveraged pre-existing AWS EC2 instances for lateral movement and data collection purposes. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has exfiltrated data from compromised VMware vCenter servers through an established C2 channel using the Teleport remote access tool. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used the PowerShell cmdlet Get-ADUser. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used the command shell to upload and install the Teleport remote access tool to a compromised vCenter Server Appliance. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has deployed a malicious kernel driver through exploitation of CVE-2015-2291 in the Intel Ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows (iqvw64.sys). | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has enumerated the vSphere Admins and ESX Admins groups in targeted environments. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has enumerated Active Directory security groups including through the use of ADExplorer, ADRecon.ps1, and Get-ADUser. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has manually deleted emails notifying users of suspicious account activity. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider stages data in a centralized database prior to exfiltration. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used compromised credentials for initial access. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used compromised Microsoft Entra ID accounts to pivot in victim environments. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has executed scripts to identify the underlying operating system to ensure it uses the correct installation package for malicious payloads. | cobertura: regra

Scattered Spider Spider enumerates a target organization for files and directories of interest, including source code, user provisioning, MFA device registration, network diagrams, and shared credentials in documents or spreadsheets. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has identified vSphere administrator accounts. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has enumerated legitimate domain accounts which are used in the targeted environment. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used proxy networks to hamper detection and has installed legitimate proxy tools on VMware vCenter and adversary-controlled VMs. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has added accounts to the ESX Admins group to grant them full admin rights in vSphere. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has assigned user access admin roles in order to gain Tenant Root Group management permissions in Azure. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has downloaded the Teleport remote access tool to compromised VMware vCenter Servers. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider searched the victim’s Microsoft Exchange for emails about the intrusion and incident response. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has redirected emails notifying users of suspicious account activity. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has leveraged legitimate remote management tools to maintain persistent access. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider creates new user identities within the compromised organization. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has impersonated organization IT and helpdesk staff to instruct victims to execute commercial remote access tools to gain initial access. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider enumerates data stored within victim code repositories, such as internal GitHub repositories. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider threat actors search the victim’s Slack and Microsoft Teams for conversations about the intrusion and incident response. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider retrieves browser histories via infostealer malware such as Raccoon Stealer. | cobertura: regra

In addition to directing victims to run remote software, Scattered Spider members themselves also deploy RMM software including TeamViewer, AnyDesk, LogMeIn, ngrok, and ConnectWise to establish persistence on the compromised network. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider adds a federated identity provider to the victim’s SSO tenant and activates automatic account linking. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used BlackCat and DragonForce ransomware to encrypt files including on VMWare ESXi servers. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has stopped the Volume Shadow Copy service on compromised hosts. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider enumerates data stored in cloud resources for collection and exfiltration purposes. | cobertura: lacuna
Scattered Spider abused AWS Systems Manager Inventory to identify targets on the compromised network prior to lateral movement. | cobertura: lacuna
Scattered Spider retrieves browser cookies via Raccoon Stealer. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has run `SYSTEMD_UNIT_PATH="/lib/systemd/ system/teleport.service` to establish persistence for the Teleport remote access tool. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider Spider searches for credential storage documentation on a compromised host. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider enumerate and exfiltrate code-signing certificates from a compromised host. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used self-signed and stolen certificates originally issued to NVIDIA and Global Software LLC. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has searched for credentials in password vaults and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions including HashiCorp Vault. | cobertura: regra
After compromising user accounts, Scattered Spider registers their own MFA tokens. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has added additional trusted locations to Azure AD conditional access policies. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider creates inbound rules on the compromised email accounts of security personnel to automatically delete emails from vendor security products. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has exfiltrated victim data to the MEGA file sharing site, SnowFlake, and AWS S3 buckets. | cobertura: regra

Scattered Spider has installed protocol-tunneling tools on VMware vCenter and adversary-controlled VMs, including Teleport.sh, Chisel (configured to communicate with trycloudflare[.]com subdomains), MobaXterm, ngrok, Pinggy, and Teleport. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has created Amazon EC2 instances within the victim's environment. | cobertura: regra

Scattered Spider enumerates cloud environments including Amazon Web Services (AWS) S3 buckets to identify server and backup management infrastructure, resource access, databases and storage containers . | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has registered domains to spoof legitimate corporate login portals. | cobertura: lacuna
Scattered Spider has created matching fake social media profiles to support new accounts created in victim environments. | cobertura: lacuna
Scattered Spider has obtained malware to use at multiple stages of operations including information stealers, remote access tools, and ransomware. | cobertura: regra

Scattered Spider has obtained tools for use throughout the attack lifecycle to include remote access software, protocol tunneling and proxy tools, exploitation frameworks, and reconnaissance tools. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used information from previous data breaches to identify employee names to be used in social engineering. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has used a combination of credential phishing and social engineering to capture one-time-password (OTP) codes. | cobertura: lacuna
Scattered Spider has used domains mirroring corporate login portals to socially engineer victims into providing credentials. | cobertura: lacuna

Scattered Spider has used help desk voice-based phishing and also called employees at target organizations and compelled them to navigate to fake login portals using adversary-in-the-middle toolkits. | cobertura: lacuna
Scattered Spider has used multifactor authentication (MFA) fatigue by sending repeated MFA authentication requests to targets. | cobertura: regra
Scattered Spider has deployed ransomware on compromised hosts and threatened to leak stolen data for financial gain. | cobertura: lacuna

Scattered Spider utilized social engineering to compel IT help desk personnel to reset passwords and MFA tokens. Scattered Spider has also used Microsoft Teams to pose as internal IT support or help desk personnel. | cobertura: lacuna
